data:
FSC.lowerOrthant_simplex_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ) :
  (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (FSC.simplex n)) (WeakSimplex.lowerOrthant t) ≤
    (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G) (WeakSimplex.lowerOrthant t)

FSC.coordinateMax_tail_lt_simplex {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ)
  (ht : 0 < t) (hne : G ≠ FSC.simplex n) :
  (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | t < WeakSimplex.coordinateMax ⋯ x} <
    (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (FSC.simplex n)) {x | t < WeakSimplex.coordinateMax ⋯ x}

FSC.coordinateMax_tail_eq_simplex_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (G : FSC.Mat n) (hG : WeakSimplex.IsCorrelation G) (t : ℝ)
  (ht : 0 < t) :
  (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 G) {x | t < WeakSimplex.coordinateMax ⋯ x} =
      (ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian 0 (FSC.simplex n)) {x | t < WeakSimplex.coordinateMax ⋯ x} ↔
    G = FSC.simplex n
